text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: *pant*, *pant*... Guh.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What are you talking about?! I can 
still go! 
To be number one, I need to do way more 
than... ngh!

Lately, there has been hesitation in her 
running. 
It feels tied to that dream she keeps 
chasing, 
becoming "number one"---
choice_data_list:
If something's bothering you, I want you 
to talk to me.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine. You don't need to worry, 
I'll pull it off perfectly!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Both the races, and the Goshiki 
Shuntaisai!!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. 
Scarlet is in quite a foul mood, isn't 
she?

Aston Machan. 
Daiwa Scarlet's classmate, 
and a horsegirl who recently transitioned 
to sprints.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Incapable of being honest, utterly 
stubborn. 
Although, you too... perhaps just a 
little?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps you failed to comprehend 
the delicate heart of a maiden.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Everyone wants to be reflected 
looking their best through the camera 
lens. 
I am sure Scarlet feels the same way.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...One must never peek beneath the surface 
at a gracefully swimming duck's paddling 
feet 
without permission.

She always strives to be worthy of being 
number one. 
Being chosen as the Divine Steed must have 
only 
made her feel the pressure even more 
deeply.

She wanted to show everyone a flawless 
performance entirely through her own 
strength. 
That was her pride, her earnest heart. 
And yet, out of pure good intentions, I 
nearly ruined that for her.
choice_data_list:
(Being overprotective isn't always the 
right answer, huh...)

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... 
...Maybe I was a bit too harsh yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
—Oh, there's someone here already. 
The sky is so blue and lovely, 
so why is Scarlet looking so gloomy?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Gloomy? What are you talking about? 
...You're imagining things. I'm totally 
fine, like always.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
No, you're not. You've been sighing 
constantly lately. 
Even though you're standing on the Tiara 
stage, 
your head is up in the clouds.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: You big silly carrot brain!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: H-Huh... What did you call me?!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Machan gave up on the Tiara. 
...Because it was just a little bit too 
far away.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That doesn't mean I don't want a 
glittering tiara anymore, though. 
If I could reach it, I'd want it.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...Machan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
However, Machan decided to become the sun 
in the sprints instead.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If you want your wish to come true, 
you don't have time to stand still. 
You go full power and do whatever it 
takes.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Though apparently, Scarlet, 
you feel differently.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: —! N-No, I don't!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Really? 
Even if it means leaning on others, doing 
whatever it takes?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Nghhh...! 
Yes! Of course I want to make it come 
true...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...B-But! 
Laying my feelings bare, asking someone 
for help... 
No way, no way, I can't do that!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
If it were that easy, I wouldn't be 
struggling like this...! 
...*pant*, *pant*...

Standing in front of the tree hollow where 
students 
confide secrets they can tell no one else— 
had she come here to pour out her heart 
too?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
What does being "number one" even mean?! 
What am I really aiming for...?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I don't know... 
But there's no way I'm giving up...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Once I finally figure out the answer, 
when that time comes—I'm gonna tell them 
straight to their face!!

She was wrestling with her troubles all 
alone. 
Yet I felt that right now, my job was to 
believe in her and watch over her.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
—That's right. 
Because I'm the horsegirl who's going to 
be number one.
